hadith:
Sales and Trade - Narrated Abu Huraira:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) David used not to eat except from the earnings of his manual labor."
message: Those who have faith and remain mindful of Allah will be delivered and protected by Him. The Prophet David, peace be upon him, exemplified dignity and self-reliance by earning his own sustenance through honest labor, teaching us that sincere effort combined with mindfulness of Allah brings honor. Remember that Al Waajid, The Perceiver, is fully aware of your intentions and efforts—nothing escapes His knowledge, so let this awareness guide you toward righteousness in all your dealings.
name:
Al Waajid - الْوَاجِدُ - The Perceiver

Al Waajid signifies Allah's ability to perceive and identify all things, conveying that nothing is hidden from Him. This name reflects the belief that Allah knows everything and can find what may be lost to human perception. It originates from Arabic, with 'waajid' derived from the root that encompasses concepts of presence and realization.
